name: FULL STEAM AHEAD TO THE RESCUE
author: lluq
description: Drive a steam locomotive 1600 m to an accident site in 120 seconds: shovel coal, vent pressure before the tank blows and brake to stop right at the end of the track.

descriptions.en: Drive a steam locomotive 1600 m to an accident site in 120 seconds: shovel coal, vent pressure before the tank blows and brake to stop right at the end of the track.
descriptions.it: Guida una locomotiva a vapore per 1600 m fino al luogo di un incidente in 120 secondi: spala carbone, sfiata la pressione prima che la caldaia esploda e frena al punto giusto.
